title: 각종분쟁조정위원회등의조정조서등에대한집행문부여에관한규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Grant of Writs of Execution and Notification, etc.)
(1) A court clerk, etc. shall compare the authentic copy of the record submitted by the applicant with the copy of that record forwarded by the mediation committee pursuant to Article 6 (2), verify that they correspond, and then grant a writ of execution.
(2) Where a court clerk, etc. grants a writ of execution pursuant to paragraph (1), the clerk shall make an additional entry to that effect on the copy of the record and notify the mediation committee using attached Form 2.
(3) Upon receiving notification under paragraph (2), the mediation committee shall, without delay, enter on the original record the fact that a writ of execution was granted for the applicant or respondent, the date of granting it, and the name of the court.
